headline: Fixes for the room list, message box and synced drafts

items.text: macOS: typing two hyphens no longer leaves an extra dash or stops typing. Smart dashes and text replacements now apply cleanly.
After time in the background, the room list no longer shows an old last message for an active room, such as one with an agent replying.
A draft written on another device now also appears when you come back to a room or to the app, not only when you open the room.
